title: Crown and Choir
author: Jude Nakamura
blurb: Marguerite Nakamura, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
